name: Setup
why: The project settings a cloud thread starts on, each lane held to one metric
ideal: The project starts every thread on the right model, a clean environment and a narrow network, with no key in sight.

sources.title: Claude Code Docs: Configure cloud environments
Claude Code Docs: Let Claude coordinate ongoing work with Projects

steps.name: General
steps.rule: The thread model and effort fit the task: the default for build work, a smaller model for docs and lint.

steps.name: Environment
steps.rule: The cloud environment holds no key in a variable, and a thread starts fast on it.

steps.name: Network
steps.rule: No thread hits a blocked host, and the allow list holds only hosts a thread uses.

steps.name: Secrets
steps.rule: No secret appears in a log or a file, and a thread never asks for a key twice.

steps.name: Script
steps.rule: The setup script passes its smoke test, adds little time and hits its cache.

steps.name: Local
steps.rule: A local thread ends clean and pushed, and logs each Remote Control and Chrome step.
